newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ details exec share option plan.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ details exec share option plan.

text.p: Air New Zealand said on Monday a further 2.37 million options had been granted on October 31 to 58 executives of the company.
The issue involves 1,537,250 "A" share options and 827,750 "B" share options.

The base reference price, on which the eventual exercise price will be calculated, was NZ$3.03 for A shares and $3.72 for B shares -- a discount of five percent from average market prices on September 3-9.
In total, 4.4 million options are now outstanding under the executive share option plan, equating to one percent of the company's total issued share capital.
